80816.subject: 🕵️ OpenAI taps in FBI over spy device
80816.body:
———————————————————————————

## Top Stories

**BTC** $83,364 (-0.1%) | **ETH** $2,501 (-0.2%) | **SOL** $107 (0.3%)

* OpenAI refers employee to FBI after discovering a [sophisticated recording device ](https://x.com/OpenAINewsroom/status/2110095403198849132?s=20)planted in their facility

* Houthi missile strike reportedly hits Saudi Aramco headquarters in Dhahran as Brent tops [$106](https://x.com/CryptoSavingExp/status/2110219154469060995)

* Michael Saylor says Bitcoin's bear market is over, predicts a surge back above [$100K](https://www.chooserich.live/story/michael-saylor-bitcoin-bear-market-785hmcs)

* Trump official orders CFTC to retract [insider trading referral](https://x.com/unusual_whales/status/2110032059976872205) over pre-announcement oil trades

* Solana's Alpenglow upgrade targets October 21 mainnet launch with [150ms finality](https://www.chooserich.live/story/solana-alpenglow-consensus-upgrade-launch-v5832fc)

* Spot bitcoin ETFs post [$175.6M](https://www.chooserich.live/story/fidelity-etf-buys-bitcoin-cnrvtya) in net inflows as ETH ETFs add $24.8M

* CFTC publishes its first proposed crypto market regulatory framework, comments due [December 14](https://www.chooserich.live/story/cftc-crypto-regulatory-framework-8x22qze)

* Strive reportedly buys 3,311 BTC, bringing total holdings to [32,773 Bitcoin](https://www.chooserich.live/story/strive-buys-bitcoin-5iexepe)

* The [Shadow Accounts](https://www.chooserich.live/story/starknet-shadow-accounts-privacy-spawk46) privacy feature is now live on Starknet

* Ripple partners with Stripe-owned Privy to bring [embedded wallets](https://www.chooserich.live/story/ripple-privy-embedded-wallets-xrp-csad7ny) to XRP

* Ledger asks resellers in six Southeast Asian countries and Hong Kong to suspend sales amid [tampering probe](https://www.chooserich.live/story/ledger-resellers-suspend-sales-tampering-hz3wyww) — Media Market Saturn pulls Ledger products from stores and online platforms amid [tampering reports](https://www.chooserich.live/story/mediamarktsaturn-pulls-ledger-tampering-44w8fng)

* Google Gemini Argon watches human cornhole video, builds simulation, and drives Apptronik Apollo humanoid to sink [seven straight shots](https://x.com/Google/status/2110041301253075358)

* Citadel Securities and BNY reportedly complete first blockchain-based [tokenized US Treasury](https://www.chooserich.live/story/citadel-bny-tokenized-treasury-transaction-56smpt9) transaction

* IEA says the [diesel supply squeeze](https://x.com/CNBC/status/2110280956103766180) will last well into 2027 amid Iran war disruption

* [Yield Field deed](https://opensea.io/collection/yield-field-deeds) NFTs sell out instantly at 1 ETH Dutch auction
